look_here_first: Start with the deciduous feathery branchlets and buttressed wet-site trunk. Baldcypress is a large deciduous conifer with flat two-ranked leaves on many lateral shoots, fibrous reddish-brown bark, round woody cones, and often knees or a swollen fluted base near water.
